positions.source_passage: Rural Health Hospitals can diagnosis stroke victims with AI generated interpretation of CT Head's and could increase good patient prognosis IF neighboring hospital physicians will accept AI interpretation and a transfer when Rural Hospitals only have AI interpretation when a Radiologist is unavailable to provide a stat reading.
positions.position_gist: Argues the benefit of AI head-CT interpretation in rural hospitals should be judged against the realistic alternative available in that setting—no stat radiologist reading at all—rather than against specialist-comparator performance, conditioned on receiving facilities accepting the AI interpretation.

positions.source_passage: Transferring patients to a more skilled facility based on patients illness could result in full recovery, timing is the key.
positions.position_gist: Emphasizes that timeliness of escalation/transfer is decisive, implying that delayed or failed escalation (under-escalation) carries substantial clinical cost that should weigh in evaluating care escalation functions.
